AI models, vision & web search

SAO Intelligents can download and prepare your selected local AI automatically after you sign in. The first download needs internet access and a browser with WebGPU support; later launches reuse the browser's model cache.

Faster replies: Nova Quick (0.5B) is the default because it generates answers faster and uses less graphics memory. Choose Nova Balanced or Nova Advanced when you prefer stronger reasoning and can wait longer. Model speed depends on your computer. The first download requires internet.
⚡Nova QuickFastest · lower memory use
✦Nova BalancedEveryday use · balanced
◈Nova AdvancedLarger model · more memory
These modes do not set a reply-length cap. Fast mode sends less previous chat history to the model; Balanced and Detailed keep more context. The selected model and your computer's GPU determine generation speed.
Choose how SAO Intelligents explains things. This changes the instructions sent to the model, not its underlying size.
Checking browser support…
Automatic setup starts after you sign in. Keep this tab open during the first download.
Web search: Turn on Search beside the message box when you need current information. Search uses the local Python helper and requires internet access. It is separate from the AI model.
File attachments: You can attach pictures and videos from your computer and preview them in chat. Image understanding uses a local BLIP captioning model, with the older captioner as a fallback. If you ask to identify an anime or manga character, SAO Intelligents can also download a CLIP visual-matching model and rank likely candidates (including One Piece characters). Similarity matches are clues, not proof; the model can still confuse characters. Video attachments are sampled into a few frames. First-time model downloads require internet.
